definition: A written document in which a manufacturer or importer certifies that a children's product complies with the applicable children's product safety rules, based on testing at a CPSC-accepted laboratory.
Regulation (EU) 2023/988, applicable from 13 December 2024, setting safety requirements for consumer products placed or made available on the Union market.
A substance meeting the criteria in REACH Article 57, placed on the ECHA Candidate List, which triggers notification and communication duties for suppliers of articles.
